_comment: Small, TRACKED file. Names the DEM to fetch and where the authoritative
per-sample regression targets live. NO large data is ever committed.
The DEM is fetched keyless via the lsdtt-fetch-raster CLI (Copernicus
GLO-30 on AWS / Microsoft Planetary Computer -- NO API key), clipped to the
bounding box below into a temporary workdir by
tests/scripts/run_cosmo_validation.py, and deleted after the run.
TODO fields must be confirmed against the LSDTopoTools data repo before an
accepted run is frozen; the harness treats unresolved TODOs as blocking.
description: Dethier et al. (2014) Front Range basin-averaged 10Be erosion rates; small, low-relief catchments chosen to shake out the harness before GB-scale Himalayan datasets.

published_reference.citation: Dethier, D.P., Ouimet, W., Bierman, P.R., Rood, D.H., Balco, G. (2014), Geology 42(2), 167-170.
published_reference.calculator: TODO: original calculator + version reported by the study (CRONUS vX / expage); record here when populating the sample table

dem.dem_source_note: Keyless. Driven through the lsdtt-fetch-raster CLI, which retrieves and clips Copernicus GLO-30 from AWS Open Data (dem_source: cop30_aws) or Microsoft Planetary Computer (dem_source: planetary_computer) with NO account or API key. Set dem_source to planetary_computer to use the PC STAC mirror instead.
dem.target_epsg_note: UTM 13N (EPSG:32613) for the Colorado Front Range. The cosmo CLIs require a PROJECTED CRS, so the DEM is warped to UTM at fetch time. Confirm the zone matches the populated sample-catchment footprint.
dem.resolution_choice_note: This keyless path delivers Copernicus GLO-30 (30 m). The CAIRN paper used SRTM 90 m throughout (plan open question 7); COP30 vs SRTM90 is a DOCUMENTED, attributable difference in the validation (DEM resolution + product), not a bug -- record it alongside the muon-scheme residual in the summary.

data_repo._comment: The authoritative per-sample regression targets (lat/lon, concentration, uncertainty, standard, published rate) live in the LSDTopoTools GitHub data repositories, per CAIRN section 9 - NOT in the paper tables. Confirm the exact repo + path when populating the sample table.
